svg.title: A Brass Clockwork Orrery
svg.desc: An animated brass clockwork orrery. Each ring gear carries a planet and revolves around the sun with a period proportional to the planet's real orbital period (Mercury 88 d, Venus 225 d, Earth 365 d, Mars 687 d, Jupiter 4333 d, Saturn 10759 d, Uranus 30687 d, Neptune 60190 d), so the planets orbit at their true relative speeds. The toothed wheels visibly mesh and turn as they drive the rings, and the day-and-night shadow sweeps across each planet as it turns.
svg.text: · THE PLANETARY GEAR TRAIN · PLANETS AT THEIR TRUE RELATIVE SPEEDS ·
